blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.
blocks.zh: 空间智能要求将视觉观测与几何、物体和环境的持续状态联系起来。 光是图像就让这些关系隐含下来,而断开的注释则使得在共同的参考下很难研究外观,相机运动和场景变化. 我们引入了空间铸币局,它收集了5 280个三维住宅场景配置,配有可编辑资产和对齐的视觉、几何和时间数据。 其模式包括地板图,视角和全景RGB,度量深度,点云,网格,例级3D边框,以及相机轨迹与视频对齐. 共享的场景坐标将跨视图和时间的观测链接起来;可编辑的源场景可以使更多的相机路径和控制对象改变. 我们描述了数据表达和构建工作流程,并讨论了底板规划条件下的3D生成,几何重建,实例层面的感知,相机条件下的视频生成,共享世界模型,以及场景编辑中的应用. 受控相机和场景变化支持空间感知和世界模型研究. 公共项目页面提供视频和交互式的彩色点云预览.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Understanding a three-dimensional environment requires more than recognizing objects in the current view. It requires knowing how objects are arranged in space and anticipating what would be observed from another viewpoint or after a change to the environment. Connecting visual observations to spatial structure and its changes is a central aspect of spatial intelligence. World models offer a way to learn these relationships by predicting subsequent observations conditioned on prior observations, camera motion, and actions that modify the scene. In three-dimensional environments, these predictions should be visually plausible, follow the specified camera trajectory, and preserve consistent geometry and object states across viewpoints and revisits. Learning and evaluating these capabilities requires images and videos explicitly associated with the underlying geometry, camera poses, and scene states, so that visual changes can be traced to their spatial causes.
blocks.zh: 理解三维环境需要的不仅仅是当前视图中的识别对象. 它要求了解物体如何在空间中排列,并预测从另一个角度或环境变化后将观察到什么。 将视觉观测与空间结构及其变化相连接是空间智能的一个核心方面. 世界模型通过预测以先前观测为条件的后期观测,相机运动,以及修改场景的行动,提供了学习这些关系的方法. 在三维环境中,这些预测应当具有可视性,遵循指定的相机轨迹,并保持一致的几何和物体状态,跨越视线并重新审视。 学习和评估这些能力需要与基础几何,相机姿势,场景状态明确相关的图像和视频,这样可以将视觉变化追溯到其空间原因.

blocks.en: Existing datasets and simulation environments provide complementary foundations for spatial learning. RealEstate10K associates video observations with recovered camera trajectories ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) ; Hypersim pairs photorealistic indoor imagery with geometric and semantic annotations ( Roberts et al., 2021 ) ; and ProcTHOR provides diverse procedural environments for embodied interaction ( Deitke et al., 2022 ) . As summarized in Figure 1 , these resources differ in their coverage of paired layouts, visual observations, geometry, and editable scene states. Access to individual modalities does not by itself provide matched sequences in which camera motion and object changes can be varied independently. Studying such controlled spatial variation requires observations, camera trajectories, and persistent object identities coordinated within a common scene reference: the same route observed before and after an object edit, or the same scene state observed from multiple viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 现有的数据集和模拟环境为空间学习提供了互补的基础. RealEstate10K将视频观测与已恢复的相机轨迹(周等,2018年)相接;Hypersim将相片现实化室内图像与几何和语义注释相配(Roberts等,2021年)相接;ProcTHOR为所体现互动提供了多样的程序环境(Deitke等,2022年). 如图1所概述,这些资源在对等布局、视觉观察、几何和可编辑的场景状态的涵盖范围上各不相同。 获取单个模式本身并不提供相机运动和物体变化可以独立变化的相机序列. 研究这种可控制的空间变异需要观测、相机轨迹和在共同场景参考范围内协调的持久物体身份:在物体编辑之前和之后观察到的相同路线,或从多个角度观察到的相同场景状态。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Data modalities and scene controllability. Representative resources span captured video ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) , indoor scans ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) , synthetic structure and appearance ( Zheng et al., 2020 ; Fu et al., 2021 ; Roberts et al., 2021 ) , and interactive environments ( Deitke et al., 2022 ) . Filled circles identify documented released products; triangles identify products obtained through rendering, processing, or source-asset access. Dashes indicate features not specified in the compared release. Availability is described at resource level. Spatial Foundry combines 5,280 furnished configurations with aligned observations and editable source scenes.
blocks.zh: 图 1:数据模式和场景可控性. 代表性资源横跨被捕获视频(周等,2018年),室内扫描(叶什旺斯等,2023年),合成结构和外观(郑等,2020年;傅等,2021年;罗伯茨等,2021年),互动环境(德克等,2022年). 填充的圆圈识别有文件证明的放出出产品;三角圈识别出通过渲染,加工,或源资产访问获得的产品. Dashes 表示比较放出时未指定的特性. 在资源一级介绍了可用性。 空间铸币局将5 280个配备配置与对齐的观测和可编辑源场景结合起来。

blocks.en: To support these controlled comparisons, we introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations and a scene-based pipeline for producing aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Each configuration combines a residential layout with a furnishing arrangement. GPT-6 generates structured layouts from residential rules, human reviewers check their spatial usability, and Blender assembly with Infinigen assets produces the furnished source scenes. The collection spans US-style residential layouts with varied room compositions and furnishing arrangements. Editable source scenes retain metric geometry and object structure, supporting perspective and panoramic RGB observations, depth maps, meshes, point clouds, and instance-level 3D bounding boxes. Camera trajectories associate video observations with per-frame camera poses, while scene edits provide explicit records of changes to object placement and appearance. The source scenes allow additional observations to be rendered under specified cameras and object configurations.
blocks.zh: 为了支持这些可控的比较,我们引入了空间铸造,一个5 280个装配的3D住宅场景配置集,以及一个以场景为基础的管道,用于制作相接的视觉、几何和时间数据。 每个配置都结合了住宅布局和家具安排. GPT-6从住宅规则中生成结构化布局,人类审查员检查其空间可用性,而用Infinigen资产进行Blender组装则产生有家具的源场景. 馆藏内容涵盖美国风格的住宅布局,各式各样的房间组成和家具安排。 可编辑源场景保留了公尺几何和对象结构,支持视角和全景RGB观测,深度地图,网点,点云,和例级3D边框. 相机轨迹将视频观测与每帧相机相接相接相机,而场景编辑则提供对象放置和外观变化的明确记录. 源场景允许在指定的相机和对象配置下进行额外的观测.

blocks.en: The central organizing principle is to separate changes in observation from changes in the environment . With a scene held fixed, different camera trajectories produce observations of the same geometry and object configuration. With a camera trajectory held fixed, controlled edits produce corresponding sequences before and after a scene change. Multiple observer cameras can additionally record a shared sequence of scene states. These controlled comparisons connect appearance to the spatial variables that determine it, supporting supervision and evaluation beyond isolated images. Potential applications include geometric reconstruction, 3D instance perception, camera-conditioned video generation, and prediction of the visual consequences of scene edits.
blocks.zh: 中心组织原则是将观测变化与环境变化区分开来. 在固定的场景下,不同的相机轨迹产生相同的几何和物体配置的观测结果. 在固定相机轨迹的情况下,可控编辑在场景变化前后产生相应的序列. 多个观察相机可以额外记录一个共享的场景状态序列. 这些可控比较将外观与决定外观的空间变量相连接,支持超出孤立图像的监督和评价. 潜在的应用包括几何重建,3D实例感知,相机所附带条件的视频生成,以及对场景编辑的视觉后果的预测.

blocks.en: This data organization supports floor-plan-conditioned 3D scene generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level spatial perception, camera-conditioned video generation, multi-agent shared world modeling, and state-conditioned scene editing. Paired floor plans and furnished environments connect layout constraints to 3D structure and appearance, while aligned observations and state records connect camera motion and object changes to their visual consequences. Together, these applications span static scene understanding and the prediction of observations during exploration and interaction.
blocks.zh: 该数据组织支持地平板3D型场景生成,几何重建,实例级空间感知,相机级视频生成,多代理共享世界建模,以及状态级场景编辑. Paired地平图和被提供的环境将布局约束与3D结构和外观相接,而对齐的观测和状态记录则将相机运动和物体改变其视觉后果相接. 这些应用共同跨越了静态场景理解和勘探和相互作用期间观测预测.

blocks.en: This report makes three contributions: 1. A collection of furnished residential environments with metric geometry, editable assets, and diverse layout and furnishing configurations. 2. A pipeline for aligned multimodal and sequential data, linking rendered observations to camera calibration, trajectories, geometry, object annotations, and scene-state records. 3. Controlled data-generation workflows that separate camera variation from scene variation, supporting reproducible comparisons for spatial perception and generation.
blocks.zh: 这份报告提出了三项意见: 1. 一套配有几何、可编辑资产以及各种布局和家具配置的家具。 2. 将观测与相机校准、轨迹、几何、物体说明和场地状态记录相连接的多式和相继数据的管道。 3. 控制下的数据生成工作流程,将相机变异与场景变异区分开来,支持空间感知和生成的可再生比较.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Indoor 3D Datasets and Simulation Environments
blocks.zh: 2.1 室内三维数据集和模拟环境

blocks.en: Captured indoor datasets connect visual observations with reconstructed geometry. ScanNet++ provides high-fidelity scans, registered imagery, and semantic annotations ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) , while Replica and HM3D supply reconstructed indoor environments for visual and embodied research ( Straub et al., 2019 ; Ramakrishnan et al., 2021 ) . Synthetic resources expose additional structure: Structured3D pairs rendered observations with structural annotations ( Zheng et al., 2020 ) , 3D-FRONT provides furnished layouts and textured assets ( Fu et al., 2021 ) , and Hypersim associates photorealistic imagery with dense geometric and semantic supervision ( Roberts et al., 2021 ) . ProcTHOR supports embodied interaction in procedurally generated environments ( Deitke et al., 2022 ) , while Aria Synthetic Environments provides synthetic egocentric observations with camera trajectories and structured scene annotations ( Project Aria, n.d. ) .
blocks.zh: 被捕获的室内数据集将视觉观测与重建的几何相连接. ScanNet++提供高纯度扫描,注册图像,和语义说明(Yeshwanth等,2023年),而Replica和HM3D供给重建了室内环境,用于视觉和内涵研究(Straub等,2019年;Ramakrishnan等,2021年). 合成资源暴露出额外结构:结构d3 D对提出带有结构说明的观测(Zheng等,2020年),3D-FRONT提供布局和纹理资产(Fu等,2021年),Hypersim将光现实主义图像与密集几何和语义监督联系起来(Roberts等,2021年)。 ProcTHOR支持在程序生成环境中所包含的互动(Deitke等,2022年),而Aria合成环境则提供合成自我中心观测,并带有相机轨迹和结构化场景说明(Project Aria, n.d.).

blocks.en: These resources emphasize captured appearance, structural understanding, furnished assets, or interactive simulation. For studying controlled spatial changes, recorded views and fixed observation sequences alone provide limited access to matched camera and object variations: observing the same route before and after a chosen edit requires editable geometry and coordinated state records. Spatial Foundry organizes 5,280 furnished residential configurations around paired 2D floor plans and 3D environments, with perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, meshes, point clouds, instance annotations, and trajectory–video correspondences. Its scope connects layout-conditioned generation and static perception to sequential observation within the same residential assets. Editable scenes allow camera paths and object configurations to be varied independently, yielding task-specific pairs with explicit geometric and state references.
blocks.zh: 这些资源强调捕捉到的外观、结构理解、提供资产或交互式模拟。 对于研究被控制的空间变化,仅记录的视图和固定的观测序列就提供了有限的对相匹配相机和对象变化的访问:在选择的编辑前后观察相同的路线需要可编辑的几何和协调的状态记录. Space Foundry组织5,280个配有2D平面图和3D环境的住宅配置,其中包含视角和全景RGB,度量深度,中间线,点云,实例说明和轨迹-视频对应. 其范围将布局有条件的生成和静态感知与同一住宅资产内的相继观测相接. 可编辑的场景允许相机路径和对象配置独立地相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相相去相相去相相相相相相相去相去相去相去相去相相去相相去相相相相相相相相相相去相去相去相去相去相相相去相相相相相相相相相相相相相去相去相去相相相

blocks.en: 2.2 Controllable Generation and Spatial World Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 可控一代和空间世界模型

blocks.en: Camera-conditioned generation and interactive world models aim to predict observations under specified motion or actions. RealEstate10K supplies video frames with camera trajectories recovered through SLAM and bundle adjustment ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) . CameraCtrl introduces explicit camera-pose conditioning for video diffusion, and CameraCtrl II extends camera-controlled generation to dynamic scene exploration ( He et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2025b ) . Recurrent world models learn compact predictive environment representations ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) ; Genie learns action-controllable environments from unlabeled video through a latent action model ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) . Atlas combines visual and geometric inputs in a shared spatial context for camera-controlled generation, reconstruction, and simulation ( World Labs Team, 2026 ) . VSI-Bench evaluates visual-spatial reasoning from sequential video observations ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .

VSI-Bench通过相继的视频观测来评价视觉-空间推理(Yang等,2025年).

blocks.en: These approaches make camera control, persistent context, and interaction central to visual generation. Their supervision also highlights a data requirement: recovered camera trajectories describe viewpoint changes, whereas latent actions learned from video do not directly specify metric object transforms. Relating a visual change to a particular camera motion or object edit requires corresponding geometric and state records. Spatial Foundry supplies these references through calibrated observations, paired camera trajectories and videos, persistent instance identities, and recorded scene edits. Holding the scene fixed provides camera-conditioned sequences; holding the camera path fixed provides before-and-after edit pairs. Multiple cameras can observe the same state sequence, extending this supervision to cross-view consistency, revisitation, and shared world modeling.
blocks.zh: 这些方法使相机控制,持续上下文,互动成为视觉生成的核心. 它们的监督也突出了一项数据要求:回收的相机轨迹描述观点的变化,而从视频中吸取的潜在动作并没有直接指定度量对象变换. 将视觉变化与特定相机运动或对象编辑联系起来需要相应的几何和状态记录. 空间铸币局通过校正观测、对相机轨迹和录像、持续实例身份和记录的场景编辑提供这些参考文献。 持有固定的场景提供相机条件的序列;持有固定的相机路径提供前后的编辑对. 多个相机可以观测到相同的状态序列,将这种监督扩展到交叉视野的一致性,再现,以及共享的世界建模.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Overview
blocks.zh: 3 数据集概览

blocks.en: 3.1 Residential Environments
blocks.zh: 3.1 住宅环境

blocks.en: The collection contains 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations. Each configuration combines an architectural layout, structural geometry, and a particular arrangement of furniture and objects. The scenes are generated from U.S. residential design priors, GPT-6 floor-plan definitions, and Infinigen-based Blender assembly. Human review checks room connectivity, passage clearance, and stair access. Variation in room combinations, circulation paths, functional templates, and furnishing arrangements produces diverse US-style residential environments. Multiple furnishing configurations can share a layout, providing variation in both architectural structure and interior contents.
blocks.zh: 馆藏有5,280个装配的住宅三维场景配置. 每个配置都结合了建筑布局,结构几何,以及家具和物品的特定安排. 场景出自美国住宅设计前身,GPT-6地平面平面定义和以Infinigen为主的Blender组装. 人文审查检查室互联互通,通过许可,楼梯进出. 房间组合、环流路径、功能模板和家具安排的多变产生了多种美国式的居住环境。 多重家具配置可以共享一个布局,既提供建筑结构,也提供内部内容的变异.

blocks.en: The source assets retain explicit geometry and object transforms. Distances and object dimensions use meters. Floor plans describe the arrangement of rooms and structural boundaries; meshes represent surfaces; point clouds provide sampled geometry. The stored geometry retains its original metric coordinates.
blocks.zh: 源资产保留了明显的几何和对象变换. 距离和物体尺寸使用仪表。 平面图描述房间和结构边界的排列;间隙代表地表;点云提供被采样的几何. 所储存的几何图案保留了原来的公分坐标.

blocks.en: 3.2 Modalities and Correspondence
blocks.zh: 3.2 方式和通信

blocks.en: For scene s s , let 𝒢 s \mathcal{G}_{s} denote geometry and 𝒪 s \mathcal{O}_{s} the object-instance table. Observation t t is represented conceptually as o s , t = ( I s , t , D s , t , Π s , t , T s , t wc , τ s , t ) , o_{s,t}=\big(I_{s,t},D_{s,t},\Pi_{s,t},T^{\mathrm{wc}}_{s,t},\tau_{s,t}\big), (1) where I I is RGB, D D is metric depth, Π \Pi specifies the projection model and calibration, T wc T^{\mathrm{wc}} maps camera coordinates to world coordinates, and τ \tau is time. Instance references connect observations to 𝒪 s \mathcal{O}_{s} . This representation expresses the shared spatial and temporal associations among the modalities.

blocks.en: Perspective observations use calibrated pinhole views. Panoramic observations use an equirectangular camera model with a declared orientation. Numeric depth is stored with its units and valid-pixel mask, alongside colorized previews for visualization. Object records include instance identifiers, names or semantic descriptions where available, metric bounds, and transforms. Persistent instance identifiers establish correspondence across views within a scene, while semantic descriptions characterize the associated objects.
blocks.zh: 视角观测使用校正的针孔视图. 全景观测采用平方相机模型,并有被宣告的方向. 数字深度与其单位和有效像素口罩并存,并配有可视化的彩色预览. 对象记录包括实例标识符、现有名称或语义描述、度量界限和变换。 持久性实例标识符在某一场景中建立跨视图的对应关系,而语义描述则描述相关对象的特征.

blocks.en: Trajectory–video pairs associate each native frame with a camera pose and timestamp. Frame-level records provide the camera supervision for temporal tasks. Presentation videos retain source-frame associations when playback timing is adjusted. The application demonstrations illustrate these correspondences along room-to-room and multi-floor routes.
blocks.zh: 轨迹-视频对相机将每个原生相框与相机姿势和时间戳相接. 帧级记录为时空任务提供相机监控. 演示视频在调整回放时间时保留了源框关联. 申请演示说明这些信件沿房间到房间和多层路面。

blocks.zh: 表1:对接的数据模式。 坐标,相机校正,实例标识符,和时间戳连接每个场景内的表示.

blocks.en: 3.3 Interactive Visualization
blocks.zh: 3.3 互动视觉

blocks.en: The public project page provides videos, images, and an interactive colored point-cloud preview. Other demonstration clouds use texture/material or rendered-RGB color estimates, with the color source recorded for each product. These lightweight previews support interactive inspection of the scene geometry and complement the full source scenes and numeric data products.
blocks.zh: 公共项目页面提供视频,图像,以及交互式的有色点-云预览. 其他示范云使用纹理/材料或制成-RGB色素估计,并记录每种产品的色素出处. 这些轻量级预览支持了场景几何的交互检查,并补充了全源场景和数字数据产品.

blocks.en: 4 Scene Construction and Multimodal Data Generation
blocks.zh: 4 场景建筑和多模式数据生成

blocks.en: The construction workflow connects residential design priors to editable Blender scenes and aligned synthetic observations (Figure 3 ). GPT-6 generates structured floor-plan definitions from residential rules and functional layout templates. Human review checks spatial organization and circulation before scene assembly. Infinigen and a reusable asset and material library provide the architectural and furnishing content. The completed scene then supplies a common reference for point-cloud simulation, RGB-D rendering, instance annotations, and controlled temporal observations.
blocks.zh: 建筑工作流程将住宅设计前期连接到可编辑的Blender场景和对齐的合成观测(图3. GPT-6从住宅规则和功能布局模板中生成结构化的地平图定义. 人文审查检查现场组装前的空间组织和流通. Infinigen和一个可再利用的资产和材料库提供建筑和家具内容。 然后,完成的场景为点-云模拟、RGB-D渲染、实例说明和控制时间观测提供了共同的参考。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Scene construction and data generation. Residential rules and functional motifs condition GPT-6 layout generation. Human review checks doorways, room circulation, and stair connectivity. Blender assembly combines the accepted layout with Infinigen assets, materials, and furniture. Reference geometry supports virtual scanning and calibrated rendering, while camera trajectories and object-state changes produce aligned temporal observations.
blocks.zh: 图3:场景构造与数据生成. 住宅规则和功能动机条件为GPT-6布局生成. 人文审查检查出出入口,房间环流,楼梯连接. Blender组装结合了被接受的布局与Infinigen资产,材料,和家具. 参考几何学支持虚拟扫描和校正渲染,而相机轨迹和对象态变化则产生对齐的时间观测.

blocks.en: 4.1 Rule-Conditioned Layout Generation and Human Review
blocks.zh: 4.1 有规则规定的布局生成和人文审查

blocks.en: U.S. residential design guidance, including the International Residential Code ( International Code Council, n.d. ) , provides priors for openings, circulation, and stair organization. We encode these requirements together with construction parameters, such as wall thickness, into a structured rule set. The design reference organizes these priors at three spatial scales: dwelling footprint and floor organization, room-level functional layouts, and fixture and storage placement. Footprint templates include compact rectilinear plans and winged arrangements such as L-, T-, and U-shaped plans; floor organization specifies how rooms and circulation connect across levels. At room scale, kitchen templates vary counter arrangements and island or peninsula placement, while bathroom templates vary fixture combinations and access from a hall, an adjacent bedroom, or a primary suite (Figure 4 ). These categories provide a structured vocabulary for layout generation, connecting the US-style character of the scenes to architectural and functional organization.
blocks.zh: 美国住宅设计指南,包括"国际住宅规范"(International Code Council, n.d.),规定了开放,流通和楼梯组织的前科. 我们把这些要求和建筑参数,如壁厚等编码成结构化的规则集。 设计参考书按三个空间尺度编排这些前科:住房足迹和地板组织、房间功能布局以及固定和储存位置。 足迹模板包括紧凑的矩形计划和翼状安排,如L-,T-和U-形状的计划;楼层组织规定房间和环流如何在各个层面相接. 在房间尺度上,厨房模板会不同的柜台安排和岛地或半岛布置,而浴室模板则会不同的固定组合以及从大厅,相邻卧室,或主套房(图4. 这些类别为布局生成提供了结构化词汇,将场景的美国风格特征与建筑和功能组织联系起来.

blocks.en: Let ℛ \mathcal{R} denote the rule set, b b the requested room and floor program, and m m a functional motif. GPT-6 produces a structured layout P P conditioned on these inputs: P ∼ q GPT ​ - ​ 6 ​ ( P ∣ b , ℛ , m ) , P = ( { Ω r } , 𝒲 , 𝒟 , 𝒮 , 𝒜 ) , P\sim q_{\mathrm{GPT\text{-}6}}(P\mid b,\mathcal{R},m),\qquad P=\big(\{\Omega_{r}\},\mathcal{W},\mathcal{D},\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A}\big), (2) where Ω r \Omega_{r} are room polygons, 𝒲 \mathcal{W} the wall specifications, 𝒟 \mathcal{D} the openings, 𝒮 \mathcal{S} the stairs and floor connections, and 𝒜 \mathcal{A} the room adjacency relations. This structured definition links the 2D plan to the geometry subsequently instantiated in Blender.

blocks.en: Functional relationships further guide layout proposals and review. Storage is positioned in relation to the spaces it serves: entry storage near the entrance, bedroom closets near sleeping areas, linen storage near bathrooms, and pantry storage near the kitchen. Kitchen work areas and bathroom fixtures are arranged with surrounding circulation space, while the grouping of kitchens, bathrooms, and laundry areas informs service-zone adjacency. For multi-floor layouts, stair placement connects circulation areas and aligns stairwells, floor openings, and landings across levels.
blocks.zh: 职能关系进一步引导布局建议和审查. 储存地点与其服务的空间有关:入口附近的入室储存、睡觉地附近的卧室壁橱、卫生间附近的亚麻布储存和厨房附近的储藏室。 厨房工作区和浴室固定装置与周围的环流空间相接,而厨房、浴室和洗衣区的组合则告知服务区的附属性。 对于多层布局,楼梯布置连接了环流区并配合了楼梯,地板开口,并跨层起落.

blocks.en: Human reviewers inspect candidate plans and their spatial realization for room connectivity, doorway clearance, blocked passages, and usable stair access between floors. Layouts are revised or filtered according to these checks. Review is repeated after furnishing to identify objects that obstruct doors, circulation, or stair landings.
blocks.zh: 人类审查人员检查候选计划及其空间实现情况,以便进行房间连接、门路清关、堵塞通道和地板之间的可用楼梯进入。 根据这些检查修改或过滤布局。 安装后重复审查,以查明有碍门、环流或楼梯着陆的物体。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Functional layout motifs. Kitchen arrangements vary from one-wall and galley layouts to L-shaped, U-shaped, island, and peninsula configurations. Bathroom motifs vary the combination and placement of fixtures. These schematic patterns illustrate the functional priors used to diversify layouts and guide circulation review.
blocks.zh: 图4:功能布局动因. 厨房安排从一墙和船坞布局到L形,U形,岛屿和半岛布局各有不同. 浴室的固定装置的组合和位置各不相同。 这些图表模式说明了用于使布局多样化并指导流通审查的功能前科.

blocks.en: 4.2 Blender Assembly and Furnishing
blocks.zh: 4.2 装配和装修

blocks.en: Accepted plans are instantiated as metric Blender scenes with floors, walls, openings, stairs, and room-level assignments. A reusable rendering library supplies surface materials such as wall finishes, floor coverings, and tiles. Infinigen ( Raistrick et al., 2024 ) and GPT-6-assisted procedural generation provide assets and scene-construction instructions for furnishing the layout. Object placement follows the room function and reviewed circulation constraints.
blocks.zh: 接受的计划被即时化为具有地板、墙壁、开口、楼梯和室级任务的平面平面。 一种可再利用的图书库供应地表材料,如墙体、地板和瓦片等。 Infinigen(Raistrick等,2024年)和GPT-6辅助程序生成提供了配置布局的资产和场景建设说明. 物体的放置遵循了房间功能并经过审查的流通限制.

Each instance associates an identifier ι i \iota_{i} with its geometry 𝒢 i \mathcal{G}_{i} , transform T i T_{i} , and semantic description ℓ i \ell_{i} . Scene construction preserves the correspondence between plan elements and their 3D realization, producing paired floor plans and furnished environments. Changing the furnishing or material choices while retaining the layout yields additional configurations under the same structural constraints.

blocks.en: 4.3 Reference Geometry and Instance Annotations
blocks.zh: 4.3 参考几何和实例说明

blocks.en: Post-processing extracts evaluated mesh geometry in a common world coordinate system. Geometric grouping, semantic inference, and review associate component meshes with object instances. A reference surface cloud is sampled from the scene, retaining the instance and semantic associations of its source geometry. This reference is kept separately from the simulated scan, so observation perturbations preserve the underlying annotation coordinates.

blocks.en: 4.6 Calibrated RGB-D and Temporal Observations

Height follows the local supporting floor and changes continuously on stairs. Speed and angular velocity vary to capture room structure and object details along the route. blocks.en: 5 Applications
blocks.zh: 5 申请

blocks.en: Spatial Foundry connects floor plans, furnished 3D scenes, visual observations, camera trajectories, and object states. These correspondences support six application areas, from generating environments from spatial layouts to predicting observations under camera motion and scene edits. Editable source assets allow task-specific observations and controlled variations to be produced within the same spatial reference.
blocks.zh: Space Foundry连接了楼层规划,提供了3D场景,视觉观测,相机轨迹,以及物体状态. 这些通信支持6个应用领域,从从空间布局生成环境到在相机运动和场景编辑下预测观测. 可编辑源资产允许在同一空间参考范围内产生针对特定任务的观测结果和可控变异.

blocks.en: 5.1 Floor-Plan-Conditioned 3D Scene Generation
blocks.zh: 5.1 楼层规划条件3D场景生成

blocks.en: Each residential scene associates a 2D floor plan with its corresponding furnished 3D environment. Across 5,280 scene configurations, these pairs cover variation in architectural layout, room composition, circulation, and furniture arrangement. They provide large-scale paired data for learning the relationship between a compact spatial layout and a complete three-dimensional interior. Multiple furnishing configurations associated with a layout further expose variation in interior contents under shared structural constraints.
blocks.zh: 每个住宅场景都将2D楼层计划与相应的3D装修环境联系起来. 在整个5 280个场景配置中,这对场景覆盖了建筑布局、房间组成、流通和家具安排的变化。 它们为学习紧凑的空间布局和完整的三维内地之间的关系提供了大规模对接数据. 与布局相关的多件家具配置进一步暴露出内部内容在共同结构限制下的差异.

blocks.en: Given a floor plan, a model can predict room geometry, recover structural organization, and arrange furniture within the resulting space. The corresponding 3D scene supplies reference surfaces, object placements, and metric dimensions, while rendered observations provide complementary appearance supervision. This pairing supports floor-plan-to-3D generation, furnished scene completion, layout-conditioned interior synthesis, and retrieval of 3D environments from 2D plans. The diversity of paired environments connects these tasks to a broad range of residential configurations.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个平面图,一个模型可以预测出房间几何,恢复结构组织,并在由此产生的空间内安排家具. 相应的三维场景提供参考地表,物体位置,和度量度,而提供观测则提供补充外观监督. 这种对接方式支持地平平面到3D生成,配备了场景完成,布局有条件的内部合成,以及从2D计划中取回3D环境. 成对环境的多样性将这些任务与广泛的住宅配置相接.

blocks.en: 5.2 Geometric Reconstruction and Multimodal Scene Representation
blocks.zh: 5.2 几何重建和多式场景代表性

blocks.en: Perspective and panoramic RGB observations are associated with camera calibration, metric depth, and explicit scene geometry. Given one or more images, a model can estimate depth, recover three-dimensional structure, or construct a representation that supports novel views. Meshes and point clouds provide geometric references, while corresponding rendered views connect recovered structure to visual appearance.
blocks.zh: 透视和全景RGB观测与相机校正相机相接,测量深度相接,并有明显的场景几何. 考虑到一个或多个图像,一个模型可以估计深度,恢复三维结构,或者构建支持新观点的表示. Meshes和点云提供了几何参考,而相应的渲染视图将恢复的结构与视觉外观相接.

blocks.en: Shared coordinates and camera models support calibrated reprojection, RGB-D fusion, and correspondence across perspective and panoramic observations. The editable scenes also allow additional camera views to be rendered for a given geometric configuration. These data support monocular and panoramic depth estimation, multiview reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, and the learning of neural scene representations with metric spatial supervision.
blocks.zh: 共享坐标和相机模型支持校正再预测,RGB-D聚变,以及跨视角和全景观测的对应. 可编辑的场景也允许为给定的几何配置提供额外的相机视图. 这些数据支持单相和全景深度估计,多景重建,小说-取景合成,以及学习神经场景表现学,并有测量空间监督.

blocks.en: 5.3 Instance-Level Spatial Perception
blocks.zh: 5.3 实例-空间感知

blocks.en: Object-instance records associate scene geometry with identifiers, transforms, bounding boxes, dimensions, and available semantic descriptions. Linking these records to RGB, depth, and point clouds supports tasks that connect visual evidence to individual objects in three-dimensional space. Given an observation, a model can localize an object, estimate its extent, and associate it with observations from other viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 物体-内相记录将场景几何与识别符,变相,边框,维度,和可得到的语义描述联系起来. 将这些记录与RGB,深度和点云相链接,支持在三维空间中将视觉证据与单个物体相连接的任务. 根据一项观察,一个模型可以将一个物体定位,估计其范围,并将其与其他观点的观察联系起来.

blocks.en: Metric geometry provides references for object size, relative position, distance, and visibility. Persistent instance identifiers support cross-view association, while component-to-object groupings connect detailed meshes to furniture-level entities. These associations support 3D object detection, object grounding, spatial relation prediction, and object-centric scene representations. They also provide a basis for constructing spatial queries whose answers are derived from scene geometry and instance records.
blocks.zh: 量子几何为对象大小,相对位置,距离,能见度提供了参考. 持久实例标识支持交叉视图关联,而组件对对象分组将详细的网格连接到家具级实体. 这些关联支持三维物体探测,物体地平面,空间关系预测,以及以物体为中心的场景表现. 它们还为构建空间查询提供了基础,其答案取自场景几何和实例记录.

blocks.en: 5.4 Camera-Conditioned Video Generation and Spatial Persistence
blocks.zh: 5.4 相机设备 视频生成和空间持久性

blocks.en: Trajectory–video pairs associate visual observations with explicit camera positions, orientations, and timestamps. Given reference observations and a target camera path, a model can learn to generate the corresponding sequence of views. Position, viewing direction, elevation, and motion timing provide distinct controls over how the environment is observed.
blocks.zh: 轨迹-视频对接将视觉观测与明显的相机位置,取向和时间戳联系起来. 鉴于参考观测和目标相机路径,一个模型可以学习生成相应的取景顺序. 位置、取景方向、高地和运动时间对如何观察环境提供了明确的控制。

blocks.en: Connected rooms and multi-floor routes extend this task beyond local viewpoint changes. Long trajectories expose new regions, introduce occlusions, and return to previously observed locations. The corresponding geometry and instance identities provide references for maintaining room layout, object placement, and cross-view consistency throughout the sequence. This setting supports camera-conditioned video generation, spatially grounded world modeling, and persistent scene representations under exploration and revisitation.
blocks.zh: 连通的房间和多层线路将这项任务超越了局部视角的变化. 长轨会暴露出新的区域,引入了隐居地,并返回了以前观察到的地点. 相应的几何和实例身份为保持房间布局,物体放置,以及整个序列的交叉视图一致性提供了参考. 这种设定支持相机条件的视频生成,基于空间的世界建模,以及正在探索和再探究的持续场景表现.

blocks.en: 5.5 Multi-Agent Collaboration and Shared World Modeling
blocks.zh: 5.5 多代理协作和共享世界模式

blocks.en: Multiple observer cameras can be associated with a common sequence of scene states. Each observer receives a partial view determined by its position, orientation, and occlusions, while object identities and scene changes remain shared. This organization provides aligned observations for learning how different agents perceive and update a common environment.
blocks.zh: 多个观察相机可以与场景状态的常见序列相接. 每个观察者都得到部分观点,其位置、取向和隐蔽性决定,而物体身份和场景变化仍然共享。 这个组织为学习不同行为者如何看待和更新共同环境提供了一致的意见。

blocks.en: Given an action and observations from one or more viewpoints, a model can predict its visual consequences for other observers and update a shared spatial representation. Object-state records specify the affected instances and their changes, while camera geometry determines where those changes become visible. The resulting data support multi-agent observation prediction, cross-view state association, collaborative scene understanding, and online world modeling in which observations and edits update a persistent shared state.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一种或多种观点的行动和观察,一个模型可以预测其对其他观测者的视觉后果并更新一个共享的空间代表。 对象状态记录指定了受影响的实例及其变化,而相机几何则决定这些变化的可见之处. 由此产生的数据支持多代理观测预测,交叉视图状态关联,协作场景理解,以及在线世界模型,其中观测和编辑更新了持续共享状态.

blocks.en: 5.6 State-Conditioned Scene Editing
blocks.zh: 5.6 国家规定的场景编辑

blocks.en: Editable source scenes support controlled object translation, rotation, insertion, removal, and appearance changes. Applying these operations to the 3D scene produces corresponding observations with updated geometry, occlusion, and object relationships. Recording the edit together with the before-and-after states connects each operation to its spatial and visual consequences.
blocks.zh: 可编辑源场景支持受控对象的翻译,旋转,插入,去除和外观变化. 将这些操作应用到3D场景中会产生相应的观测结果,并有更新的几何,隐蔽,和对象关系. 将编辑与前后状态一起记录,将每个操作与其空间和视觉后果联系起来.

blocks.en: Holding the camera path fixed yields paired sequences that isolate scene changes; varying the viewpoints reveals the same edited state from different locations. These controlled pairs support action-conditioned observation generation, edit localization, view-consistent scene editing, and prediction of persistent object changes. The source assets also enable task-specific data augmentation through changes to object configuration, materials, and lighting, with camera and scene controls recorded separately.
blocks.zh: 持有相机路径固定的输出对等序列,以隔离场景变化;不同的观点会从不同位置显示相同的被编辑状态. 这些可控对子支持动作有条件的观测生成,编辑本地化,取景一致的场景编辑,并预测持续物体变化. 源资产还可以通过改变对象配置、材料和照明,实现特定任务的数据增强,并分别记录相机和场景控制。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Application areas supported by aligned scene data. Diverse furnished environments provide paired layout and 3D content. Instance annotations connect observations to objects and metric geometry. Shared scene states support multiple observer viewpoints, while editable assets provide controlled object changes. The examples illustrate the data correspondences used for spatial perception, generation, and world modeling.
blocks.zh: 图5:由对齐的场景数据支持的应用领域. 不同的提供环境提供配对布局和三维内容. 实例说明将观测与对象和度量几何联系起来。 共享场景状态支持多个观察者视角,而可编辑资产则提供受控对象更改. 这些例子说明了用于空间感知、生成和世界建模的数据对应。
